svg.text: Approximately 1 Ω NiCr foil · direct voltage sensing · Teensy 4.1 · all analog/control signals 3.3 V
A Power path and current measurement
B Voltage measurement at the foil terminals
C Local controller and computer connection
Set voltage from measured foil resistance
Both terminal voltages are measured; Teensy subtracts them.
Designed for a supply up to 5 V; nominal division by two.
USB provides 5 V power to Teensy
Electrical schematic · matching net labels are connected · GND joins the supply negative and control ground
